question: What fast food restaurant are positioned within 100 kilometers along the travel path to Homewood Suites by Hilton San Antonio Airport, San Antonio, TX?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.565757 29.902725)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.463836 29.518635)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.565757 29.902725)',4326)::geography, 100000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-98.565757 29.902725)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
